Protein Group

Grains & Wheat Protein

About This Group

Seitan, vital wheat gluten, quinoa, amaranth, buckwheat, farro, oats, and barley.

Grains and wheat gluten provide complementary plant protein — quinoa to seitan. Included for protein-food completeness, not only high-protein claims.

FAQ

Why are plant foods not organized by cuts?
Botanical structure uses plant_part and edible_structure — not steak or roast primals.
How does bone_state apply to plants?
not_applicable — bone metadata is reserved for animal protein foods.
